name: Majo no Shokuzai
source:
After the end of the war disease of unknown cause starts to spread among prisoners with incredible speed. Priests see the source of it in bewildering  fascinating beauties - witches. They prepare a ceremony of the Atonement to prove the innocence of the body of main heroine Sedia. Witches do not feel pleasure during sex act, so only sequential public sex acts with important people can justify Sedia. Can she gain public support by the deadline?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战争结束后，一种病因不明的疾病在囚犯中以惊人速度传播。祭司们认为，疾病源头是那些令人困惑而着迷的美丽女子——魔女。他们准备举行“赎罪”仪式，证明女主角Sedia肉体的清白。魔女在性行为中不会感到快感，因此Sedia只有依次与重要人士公开发生性行为，才能证明自己无罪。她能否在期限前获得民众支持？
